scheme.title: Contact Role
scheme.description: Role a person or organization plays for a resource.

concepts.label: Licensor
concepts.description: Granted the licence under which the data is shared.

concepts.label: Host
concepts.description: Stores and serves the data (a repository, portal or server).

concepts.label: Processor
concepts.description: Transformed, cleaned or derived the data.

concepts.label: Maintainer
concepts.description: Keeps the record and the data up to date.

concepts.label: Funder
concepts.description: Paid for producing the data (prefer the funding field when only a name is known).
